summary: Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (health, profile upsert/get, assessment computations covering FCP formula, BLUE/RED/FLATTENED/UNSTABLE patterns, context_flag, list sort desc, filter by device, 404 on missing get/delete, 400 on missing reading key, no _id leak). Frontend: full Onboarding -> Profile Setup -> Home -> New Assessment (4 steps) -> Result -> History -> Profile flow works. All required testIDs present except profile-sport-input.

ui_bugs.issue: Sport field not exposed as testID 'profile-sport-input' (only 3 text inputs found; sport likely rendered as picker/chips). Non-blocking since save still succeeds with a default sport.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Also 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: expose sport selector with testID 'profile-sport-input' (or add a testID on the sport chip container) to enable full automation coverage of the sport field.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and remove props.pointerEvents in favor of style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes _id via projection and doc.pop; models are Pydantic-validated. Calculation engine matches the spec (FCP=round(0.8*(220-age)), HRR=peak-hr60, RECpct via (peak-hr180)/(peak-fcr)*100, tau via 63.2% decay, trapezoidal AURC).
Zone rules match spec: RED if UNSTABLE/FLATTENED or recpct<25; BLUE if recpct>=65 and RAPID; GREEN if recpct>=40; else YELLOW.
Endpoints correctly return 400 for missing reading keys and 404 for missing assessments on GET and DELETE.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified, sport testID missing)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ profile + assessments under a temporary TEST_dev_* device_id via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (https://safety-check-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_afetm_backend.py for regression. Zones in UI render as Spanish labels (Azul/Verde/Amarillo/Rojo), not English codes -- do not assert 'BLUE' in visible text.
